verdict.rationale: Luma documents general text-to-video, character references, and facial-expression or performance transfer onto new characters. None of this evidence shows a script-to-presenter workflow with stock or custom talking avatars that speak a pasted script, and character reference or expression transfer is only an adjacent capability. Avatar presenters are a fair question for an AI video product, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence Luma delivers it.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can paste a script and get a presenter-led video with a stock or custom avatar, no camera or studio
